title: Bounded buffer with seeded read and eviction ends
notes: S1-E-RS. Mutation: seeded read end (oldest or newest) and overwrite eviction end (never both oldest), capacity-0 rule (d3+), peek/drain and non-Copy elements (d4). ref/naive.rs is the track's .meta/example.rs plus len/peek/drain adapters (unmutated behaviour; validator fixture, must fail).
